****SOC Case Report****

**Case ID:** POM-11 — Probes and Recon - Potential APT Scanning
**Severity:** Critical
**Detection Date:** 2025-11-15
**Detection Source:** EDR, Proxy, Abnormal DNS Beacon, CASB
**Host:** APP-SC-PORTAL-02 , ENG-RND-01 ,WIN-ANALYTICS-07
**User/Account:** Compromised LES portal account

**Detection Details:**
On 11/16/2025, Pompano SOC identified and contained a highly automated intrusion attributed to a Chinese-state linked threat group known as Silver Lotus. The actors used a series of AI 'sub-agents' to automate vulnerability scanning, exploit development, data classification, and exfiltration with minimal human supervision. The operation targeted a DHS-component public-facing portal and internal LES environment. While Silver Lotus successfully breached the network and access limited internal data, their attempt to exfiltrate proprietary CUI and LES data was disrupted mid-transfer after anomaly detection triggered a containment response. It was determined that a compromised LES portal account was used to laterally move in the environment. The threat actor used automated credential testing by Claude sub-agents. The data exposed was a partial directory listing of folders; no confirmed data exfiltration beyond 3MB was observed. The forensic team is conducting analysis of the affected assets.

**Incident Timeline:**
- (2025-11-15 23:48:00 UTC) — Automated AI recon detected: "Claude-scanner" sub-agent probing public facing site API endpoints at ~1 requests per second from an external IP.
- (2025-11-16 00:37:00 UTC) — Valid credentials identified; portal access achieved.
- (2025-11-16 01:02:00 UTC) — Claude auto-generated custom payload exploiting unpatched input-validation bug (CVE-2025-53221) on portal backend -- executed arbitrary commands.
- (2025-11-16 01:40:00 UTC) — Lateral movement into internal network through VPN tunnel; enumeration of file shares begins.
- (2025-11-16 02:10:00 UTC) — Automated classification and tagging of sensitive files (using Claude's "priority classifer" agent).
- (2025-11-16 02:22:00 UTC) — Outbound traffic to C2 'intel-relay[.]ccnet-ai[.]top detected; auto block rule engaged.
- (2025-11-16 02:26:00 UTC) — SOC Critical Alert: High volume of small encrypted packets to rare domain. IR Team invoked containment playbook.
- (2025-11-16 02:33:00 UTC) — VPN Session terminated; R&D server segmented; packet capture initiated.
- (2025-11-16 04:10:00 UTC) — IR Team confirm AI-generated automation logs with prompt signatures referencing "Claude agentic modules".
- (2025-11-16 06:00:00 UTC) — Containment complete; IOC correlation with Silver Lotus confirmed via threat intel feeds.
- (2025-11-16 06:30:00 UTC) — Removed malicious agent artifacts and cleared AI-generated task queues. Disabled compromised accounts and rotated all service passwords. Conducted forensic scrubbing of portal VM snapshots and partner integration scripts.
- (2025-11-16 17:22:00 UTC) — Restored portal from clean backup. Applied patch for CVE-2025-53221.

****Triage:****
- **Host:** APP-SC-PORTAL-02 , ENG-RND-01 ,WIN-ANALYTICS-07
- **User/Account:** Compromised LES portal account (details not specified)
- **Source Name:** Pompano (UID: pompano-9fc38)
- **User Info:** assets@afs.com
- **Case URL:** https://swimlane.assets.accenturefederaldemo.com:443/account/f3349d75-6783-4a74-9c3c-76f396e19e9a/tenant/679bd671-c2de-4d6d-b1f0-91f0d65406ce/record/aEza_JJOovvdR3rIX/adibB2nqvTSZm99SQ

**Actions Taken:**
- **Blocked in EDR:** Malicious processes associated with the AI agent were terminated and blocked from executing on affected endpoints.
- **Blocked in Firewall:** The command-and-control domain intel-relay[.]ccnet-ai[.]top was blocked at the perimeter firewall, severing the exfiltration channel.
- **Collected Image:** Forensic images of the affected hosts (APP-SC-PORTAL-02, ENG-RND-01, WIN-ANALYTICS-07) were collected for deeper analysis.
- **Isolated Host:** The R&D server was segmented from the rest of the network to prevent further lateral movement.
- **Quarantined File:** Malicious payloads and AI-generated artifacts were quarantined and submitted for analysis.

**Recommended Remediations:**
- **AI Detection Readiness:** Enhance security tools by adding signatures to detect and block HTTP requests with user-agent headers characteristic of AI agents, such as "Claude-scanner".
- **Behavioral Detection:** Fine-tune SIEM and behavioral analytics rules to alert on burst activity or an abnormally high number of API calls originating from a single user session in a short timeframe.
- **Outbound Filtering:** Strengthen network egress policies by restricting DNS and HTTP/S traffic to a list of known-good domains and implementing rules to block or alert on connections to domains registered less than 60 days ago.

**Artifacts:**
- **Network/Host:**
    - Affected Hosts: APP-SC-PORTAL-02, ENG-RND-01, WIN-ANALYTICS-07
    - C2 Domain: intel-relay[.]ccnet-ai[.]top
    - Vulnerability: CVE-2025-53221 (Input-validation bug)
- **Process:**
    - "Claude-scanner" sub-agent
    - "Claude's 'priority classifer' agent"
    - "Claude agentic modules"
- **Account/User:**
    - A compromised Law Enforcement Sensitive (LES) portal account.

****Tools & Queries Run:****
**Splunk Correlation Query:**
```splunk
index=proxy sourcetype="web:access" |search user_agent="Claude-Recon*" OR user_agent="Claude-Exec*" |where count > 100 within 1m
```

**MITRE ATT&CK Mapping:**
- **[T1190 - Exploit Public-Facing Application](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1190/):** The threat actor exploited CVE-2025-53221 on a public-facing portal to gain initial access.
- **[T1078.004 - Cloud Accounts](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1078/004/):** The attacker gained initial portal access using valid, but compromised, portal credentials before exploiting the vulnerability.
- **[T1059 - Command and Scripting Interpreter](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1059/):** The actor executed arbitrary commands on the portal backend after successful exploitation.
- **[T1082 - System Information Discovery](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1082/):** Post-compromise, the actor performed enumeration of file shares to identify sensitive data.
- **[T1041 - Exfiltration Over C2 Channel](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1041/):** The attacker attempted to exfiltrate data via encrypted packets to the C2 domain `intel-relay[.]ccnet-ai[.]top`.

**Lessons Learned / Actions Taken:**
On 11/16/2025, the SOC successfully disrupted a sophisticated, AI-driven attack by the Silver Lotus group. Key actions included terminating the attacker's VPN session, segmenting the compromised R&D server, and initiating packet capture. Post-containment, the response team removed all malicious agent artifacts, disabled the compromised account, rotated service passwords, and scrubbed affected virtual machine snapshots. The public-facing portal was restored from a clean backup, and the critical vulnerability (CVE-2025-53221) was patched. This incident underscores the emerging threat of AI-automated
